title: Avatar *yzer
features:
You know about the 40% Method and love customizing your Avatar, don't you?
Allow me to present my brand new script. You no longer have to sit there and manually search for the ID of each accessory yourself. And of course, there are times when you might buy the wrong item, don't worry, I've been there too. That is exactly why I created this script "Avatar Analyzer"

You might be wondering why I created this script.
Rest assured, this script does not exploit other players in any way. It is 100% a Quality of Life script.

How to use this script?
Let's say you are playing Catalog Avatar (or any game related to avatar customization) and there is an avatar outfit you really want to buy, but you also need to save money. So, you decide to use the 40% Method. However, finding the IDs manually is very time-consuming, and mistakes can happen.

This script handles everything for you. It will accurately retrieve the ID for each of your accessories. You simply need to be wearing the Avatar you want to buy at that moment, and then run the script.

If you are on PC: Press F9 to see the results.
If you are on Mobile: Type "/console" in the chat to see the results.

** Disclaimer **
I have made this script as stable and bug-free as possible. There might be occasional errors during use because writing scripts using Delta is quite challenging for me. However, I am confident that it is very stable with minimal bugs.

Thank you for choosing my script.
(@dekchaifresh)
